basic_details.job_title: NAM Thrissur Ayurveda Therapist Recruitment 2026 – Walk-in

application_fee.details: The notification does not mention any application fee.

age_limit.details: The maximum age limit is 40 years.

qualification.details: post: Qualification Required | ayurveda therapist: Passed Kerala Government conducted or approved one-year Ayurveda Therapist Course (DAME) OR NARIP Ayurveda Therapist Course.

vacancy_details.details: The notification does not specify the exact number of vacancies and states that vacancies are anticipated.

selection_process: The selection process consists of an interview
and if there are more than 20 candidates
an objective written test will be conducted prior to the interview.
how_to_apply: Download the application profile form from the official notification or website.
Fill in all required details accurately in capital letters.
Affix a passport-size photograph to the designated space on the application profile.
Compile original certificates and self-attested copies of certificates proving qualification, age, and address.
Attend the walk-in interview on 17 October 2026 at 10:30 AM at the office of the District Programme Manager, National AYUSH Mission, Thrissur.
important_instructions: The appointment is made on a contract basis for a temporary period. Candidates must bring original certificates along with self-attested copies of certificates to the interview venue. Reporting time for the walk-in interview is 10:30 AM on 17 October 2026. If the number of candidates exceeds 20, a written test will be conducted before the interview. For additional information, candidates can contact the phone number 0487 - 2939190.

faq.question: Q1. What is the NAM Thrissur Ayurveda Therapist recruitment?
faq.answer: It is a temporary contract recruitment announced by National AYUSH Mission Thrissur for the post of Ayurveda Therapist (Female).

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: The exact number of vacancies is not specified in the notification and is anticipated.

faq.question: Q3. When is the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 17 October 2026, with reporting at 10:30 AM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the venue for the interview?
faq.answer: The interview will be held at the National AYUSH Mission District Programme Manager Office, Thrissur.

faq.question: Q5. What is the required qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed a one-year Ayurveda Therapist Course (DAME) conducted or approved by the Kerala Government, or the NARIP Ayurveda Therapist Course.
